area: ecology: the light fauna behaviour tick (LightFauna.UpdateBehavior)
summary: The tick's prism scan reads its own position once and each prism's position once (it was up to three reads a prism); IsEdibleForHerbivore gained an overload that takes the position. Same behaviour.
why: The menu slows as its cell fills (106 fps to 81-98 in a built player over 15 min); the scan reached 26.8 ms in one frame. This saves about 9% per prism (paired A/B in the editor). The spikes remain: the scan still visits every prism in range per creature, about 19 scans a second for 11 creatures. Also found: for 9% of sensed prisms the spatial index position is more than 1 cm off the transform (up to 34 m).
